name: Can I dispute my property's assessed value by the Miami-Dade County Property Appraiser?

mainEntity.name: Can I dispute my property's assessed value by the Miami-Dade County Property Appraiser?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, property owners in Miami-Dade County have the right to dispute their property's assessed value if they believe it is incorrect. The process typically involves filing a petition with the Value Adjustment Board (VAB) by a specific deadline, usually in September. You will need to provide evidence supporting your claim, such as comparable sales or an independent appraisal. Understanding this process clarity is crucial for exercising your right to appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can dispute your Miami-Dade County property's assessed value by filing a petition with the Value Adjustment Board (VAB) with supporting evidence.
